job.title: [Post] URGENT HIRING | Salesforce OMS Developer VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES is ... Salesforce Commer…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud & OMS Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and micro-services, with proven success designing and integrating OMS, PIM and ERP data flows. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and AI-assisted analysis, I bridge business requirements and technical delivery to ensure robust, scalable commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce OMS Developer VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES
cover_en.hook: I am excited about VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES’ mission to deliver cutting-edge cloud commerce and OMS solutions. With over five years building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and API-driven integrations that align perfectly with your Salesforce Commerce Cloud initiatives.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST web services and built robust data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, ensuring seamless API integration across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: OMS Design
bullets.text: I led Order Management (OMS) enhancements on SAP Commerce Cloud, creating custom workflows and promotions that improved order processing efficiency for high-volume B2B customers.

bullets.label: Data Pipeline
bullets.text: Implemented end-to-end product catalog synchronization using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, delivering reliable data migration and real-time updates.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories and functional specs, driving delivery within agile Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany. Valid German residence and work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site.

tailoring.why_company: VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES stands at the forefront of cloud-based commerce and OMS innovation, combining Salesforce’s ecosystem with advanced integration capabilities. I am drawn to your commitment to scalable, AI-enhanced solutions and see a strong fit for my SAP Commerce Cloud background, where I have repeatedly delivered high-performance, data-driven e-commerce platforms. Joining your team would allow me to leverage my expertise in API-centric architecture to accelerate your product roadmap.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and OMS expertise to help VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES accelerate its cloud commerce vision with robust, API-driven solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering OMS and integration projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java/Spring expertise to VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES. Could we discuss the Salesforce OMS Developer role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce OMS Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce OMS Developer position at VITIM CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, including OMS design, API integration and data pipelines for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your cloud commerce initiatives. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.
